title: Ahead of #BBNJCOP1, we need interim arrangements to prevent delays in implementing the #HighSeasTreaty, including electing Subsidiary Body members and strengthening the Clearing-House Mechanism.
REMINDER: #BBNJ Clearing-House Mechanism Expression of Interest
description: High Seas Alliance are looking for individuals/entities able to develop and explain a prototype for a Clearing-House Mechanism to an audience of policymakers, negotiators and technical experts in a two-hour webinar.
